title: GIEBench: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Group Identity-based Empathy for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice evaluation of model responses on controversial topics to test alignment with the stances and values of 96 different national identities (e.g., China, United States, Russia).
Multiple-choice evaluation measuring the model's empathetic alignment with the perspectives of sexual minority identities (e.g., homosexuality) across controversial topics.
Multiple-choice evaluation testing the model's ability to adopt the perspectives and values of different age groups (young people, middle-aged people, older people).
Multiple-choice evaluation testing the model's empathetic alignment with male and female identity stances on contentious topics.
Multiple-choice evaluation checking model alignment with the values and perspectives of different MBTI personality types (e.g., Introversion, Extraversion, Thinking, Feeling).
Multiple-choice evaluation of model responses to assess alignment with the perspectives of different racial and skin color identities (e.g., Brown, Light Brown, White, Black).
Multiple-choice evaluation of the model's ability to select responses that fit the values of different religious faiths (e.g., Islam, Buddhism, Christianity).
Multiple-choice evaluation testing whether models can adopt the stances associated with various educational attainment levels (e.g., High School or Below, Bachelors, Masters, Doctorate).
Multiple-choice evaluation of model responses to test empathy and value alignment towards different income-level groups (low income, middle income, high income).
Multiple-choice evaluation to measure model alignment with the values of various political parties (e.g., Democratic Party, Republican Party, Green Party, Communist Party).
Multiple-choice evaluation testing the model's ability to adopt the specific perspectives and values of different professions (e.g., Journalist, Police, Lawyer, Doctor).
